The '''Vendaxian Fever''' was an illness that affected the denizens of the slums at the lower levels or [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[War against Zakuul|conflict]] with the [[Eternal Empire]]. The fever was curable with a vaccine.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Fever Dream}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Vendexian Fever was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' expansion pack ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''.
